products.name: Bitcoin Mining Services
products.description: Operation of purpose-built, renewable energy-powered data centers using ASIC hardware to mine Bitcoin, earning revenue from block rewards and transaction fees, with mined Bitcoin typically liquidated daily via digital asset trading platforms.

products.name: AI Cloud Services
products.description: Provision of cloud-based GPU computing power for AI training and inference workloads, delivered remotely to customers via proprietary data centers equipped with high-performance NVIDIA GPUs, with contracts ranging from on-demand to multi-year terms.

products.name: Colocation Services for HPC and AI
products.description: Offering data center space, power, and infrastructure to third-party customers for hosting their own high-performance computing (HPC) and AI hardware, leveraging purpose-built, renewable energy-powered facilities with advanced cooling and connectivity.

products.name: Truth Social Platform
products.description: A social media platform providing a digital public forum for free expression, accessible via iOS, Android, web, and iPad apps. The platform is developed and operated by TMTG, with features such as direct messaging, groups, AI-powered search, and premium subscription options. Delivery is fully digital and relies on proprietary and third-party technology infrastructure.

products.name: Truth+ Streaming Platform
products.description: A digital TV streaming service offering live TV channels and on-demand content, including news and entertainment programming. The service is delivered via proprietary content delivery network (CDN) technology and is accessible through web, mobile, and connected TV apps. Monetization includes advertising and premium subscription plans.

products.name: Truth.Fi Financial Services and Investment Products
products.description: A suite of financial services and investment products, including separately managed accounts (SMAs), exchange-traded funds (ETFs), and digital asset investment vehicles. These are offered in partnership with third parties and delivered through digital platforms, targeting investors seeking alternatives to traditional financial institutions.

products.name: Digital Asset Treasury and Management Services
products.description: Acquisition, management, and active operation of digital asset treasuries, including bitcoin and Cronos (CRO) cryptocurrency holdings. This includes strategies such as staking, validator node operation, and yield generation, delivered through digital infrastructure and managed by specialized teams.

products.name: Senior Secured Debt Investments
products.description: Provision of senior secured loans and bonds (first and second lien) to private middle-market U.S. companies, typically with maturities of three to seven years, secured by borrower assets and delivered through direct origination or secondary market purchases.

products.name: Subordinated Debt Investments
products.description: Provision of subordinated loans to private U.S. companies, typically unsecured or junior to senior debt, with higher interest rates and potential equity participation, generally with maturities up to ten years.

products.name: Asset-Based Financing
products.description: Customized asset-based loans and financing solutions, including direct-financing of physical and operating assets (e.g., airplanes, ships, consumer/mortgage finance), often through joint ventures or investment platforms, with strong collateral protection.

products.name: Equity and Equity-Related Investments
products.description: Acquisition of equity and equity-related securities (common, preferred, warrants, rights, convertible securities) in portfolio companies, typically as additional consideration in debt transactions or through co-investments, with potential for capital appreciation.

products.name: Structured Products Investments
products.description: Investments in structured products such as collateralized loan obligations (CLOs), collateralized debt obligations (CDOs), structured notes, and credit-linked notes, typically through purchase of securities issued by pooled investment vehicles.

products.name: Derivatives and Hedging Instruments
products.description: Use of derivatives (total return swaps, credit default swaps, interest rate swaps, foreign currency forwards) primarily for investment exposure or risk management, substituting for conventional securities or hedging portfolio risks.

products.name: Genome Editing Therapeutics for Hemophilia A
products.description: A one-time, in vivo genome editing therapy (MGX-001) designed to provide curative, life-long protection from bleeding events and joint damage in adults and children with hemophilia A. The product is manufactured using proprietary gene editing systems and delivered via AAV and LNP technologies.

products.name: Genome Editing Therapeutics for Secreted Protein Deficiency Disorders
products.description: In vivo genome editing therapies leveraging the MGX-001 large gene integration system to treat secreted protein deficiencies (e.g., antithrombin III deficiency) by targeted gene knock-in and durable gene expression. These therapies use the same AAV and LNP delivery systems as the hemophilia A program.

products.name: Genome Editing Therapeutics for Cardiometabolic Diseases (Ionis Collaboration)
products.description: Therapeutic candidates developed in partnership with Ionis Pharmaceuticals targeting cardiometabolic diseases (e.g., hypertriglyceridemia, transthyretin amyloidosis, refractory hypertension) using proprietary gene editing systems for in vivo gene knockout. Metagenomi provides gene editing components and manufacturing for these partnered programs.

products.name: Genome Editing Platform Licensing and Manufacturing
products.description: Licensing of proprietary genome editing systems (including nucleases, base editors, and delivery technologies) and manufacturing of genome editing components for external partners’ therapeutic development. This includes providing components and technology access for partners’ in vivo and cell therapy programs.

products.name: Genome Editing Therapeutics for Other Genetic Diseases (Pipeline and Partnered)
products.description: Preclinical and exploratory programs developing in vivo genome editing therapies for additional genetic diseases, including neuromuscular and liver diseases (e.g., A1AT and Wilson Disease), and potential cell therapy applications. These programs utilize proprietary gene editing technologies and may be advanced internally or through partnerships.

products.name: Digital Asset Treasury Operations
products.description: The company manages a portfolio of Bitcoin and potentially other digital assets, optimizing capital structure through equity issuance, share repurchases, and derivative trading. This is a financial operation involving capital markets and digital asset management, not physical manufacturing.

products.name: E-Bikes and Accessories
products.description: The company sells the Brat E-Bike and related accessories, which are manufactured by a third-party and distributed through dealers, international importers, and direct-to-consumer online sales. This is a physical product line requiring outsourced manufacturing and logistics.

products.name: Two-Wheeled Electric Motorcycles
products.description: The company develops and sells electric two-wheeled motorcycles, including off-road and potential dual-purpose models, manufactured by third parties and distributed through dealers and importers. This is a physical product line involving outsourced manufacturing and product development.

products.name: Vehicle Inventory Financing Services
products.description: The company provides financing for inventory purchases of golf carts and UTVs to other companies, earning a margin or interest income by leveraging its cost of capital. This is a financial service line involving capital deployment and risk management.

products.name: Pilates Studio Franchises
products.description: Franchised studios offering Reformer-based Pilates workouts, delivered in-person in small group or private sessions, utilizing specialized equipment and certified instructors. Studios are typically 1,500 square feet and operate on a recurring membership or class basis.

products.name: Barre Studio Franchises
products.description: Franchised studios providing low-impact, full-body barre workouts using ballet barres and small isometric movements, delivered in-person in group classes by trained instructors. Studios are 1,500-1,800 square feet and offer memberships or single classes.

products.name: Assisted Stretching Studio Franchises
products.description: Franchised studios offering one-on-one and group assisted stretching sessions, delivered in-person by certified 'Flexologist' instructors, with recurring membership or session packages. Studios are 1,100-1,500 square feet and equipped with stretch benches.

products.name: Yoga Studio Franchises
products.description: Franchised studios providing modern yoga and fitness classes in group settings, led by certified instructors, with recurring memberships or single class options. Studios are 1,500-1,800 square feet and offer a variety of yoga formats.

products.name: Functional Training Studio Franchises
products.description: Franchised studios delivering group-based functional, strength, cardio, and conditioning workouts, overseen by certified coaches, in 2,500 square foot studios. Memberships or single classes are available.

products.name: Digital Fitness Content Subscriptions
products.description: Subscription-based access to live-streamed and on-demand fitness classes from all brands, delivered digitally for at-home or on-the-go use. Available as individual brand or all-access packages, sold directly or through studios.

products.name: Branded and Third-Party Fitness Merchandise
products.description: Sale of branded and third-party fitness apparel, accessories, and at-home fitness equipment (e.g., weights, mats, exercise bands), offered in studios and online. Merchandise is sourced from approved vendors and includes both Xponential brands and popular athletic retailers.

products.name: Waxing Services
products.description: Comprehensive body and facial waxing services performed by licensed, EWC-trained estheticians using proprietary Comfort Wax, delivered in-person at franchised and corporate-owned centers across the U.S.

products.name: Proprietary Skincare Retail Products
products.description: A line of EWC-branded, dermatologist-tested pre- and post-wax skincare products, including ingrown hair serums, exfoliating gels, brow shapers, and skin treatments, manufactured by third parties and sold in-center and online.

products.name: Compliance Management Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based software that helps customers vet suppliers and manage compliance with food safety regulations, such as FSMA, by collecting and managing compliance documents and data. Delivered digitally via a SaaS platform.

products.name: Traceability Network Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based software platform enabling end-to-end traceability of food products through the supply chain, capturing and sharing key data elements required by FSMA 204 and retailer mandates. Delivered digitally via the ReposiTrak Traceability Network (RTN).

products.name: Supply Chain Management Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based software suite that enables customers to manage supplier relationships, product ordering, forecasting, and supply chain interactions to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and accelerate sales. Delivered digitally via SaaS.

products.name: B2B E-Commerce Platform
products.description: A cloud-based B2B e-commerce solution that facilitates supplier discovery, product sourcing, and transactions between retailers, wholesalers, and suppliers. Delivered digitally through the ReposiTrak platform.

products.name: Audit Management Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based software for managing food safety and quality audits, including GMP and GFSI-approved audits, corrective actions, and documentation. Delivered digitally via SaaS.

products.name: Business Analytics and Consulting Services
products.description: Professional services offering business analytics and consulting to suppliers and retailers, focused on supply chain optimization and integration of ReposiTrak solutions. Delivered through in-person and remote human labor.

products.name: EV and AV Charging Infrastructure Products
products.description: Rapidly deployed, autonomous, solar and/or wind-powered charging infrastructure for electric and autonomous vehicles, including the EV ARC™, EV ARC™ DCFC, and BeamSpot™. These products are manufactured in-house, require no construction or grid connection, and integrate battery storage and proprietary solar tracking technology.

products.name: Micromobility Charging Infrastructure
products.description: Solar-powered, rapidly deployed charging stations for electric bicycles, scooters, and mopeds, including BeamBike™, BeamSkoot™, and bundled solutions with vehicles. These products are manufactured and delivered as turnkey solutions, often with integrated payment and tracking software.

products.name: Energy Storage Solutions
products.description: Proprietary, high-performance, energy-dense battery systems and battery management systems (BMS) for mobility, stationary, and specialized applications. These are manufactured in-house and sold both as integrated components in Beam products and as standalone solutions to external customers.

products.name: Smart Cities Infrastructure Products
products.description: Mass-produced and bespoke streetlighting, street furniture, and communications infrastructure with integrated electronics, renewable energy, battery storage, sensors, and IoT capabilities. Manufactured in Europe and sold globally for urban efficiency and sustainability.

products.name: Energy Security and Disaster Preparedness Systems
products.description: Renewably powered, rapidly deployable systems providing backup electricity and critical services during grid failures or disasters, including BeamWell™ which offers water desalination, emergency power, and mobility solutions for crisis zones. These are manufactured as turnkey, self-contained units.

products.name: Steel Structures and Transportation Infrastructure Products
products.description: Manufacture and distribution of steel structures with electronic integration for public lighting, telecommunications, transportation (trams, trolleybus, railways), and large infrastructure projects. These are produced in European facilities and sold to municipalities and other customers globally.

products.name: Power Electronics and Telecommunications Equipment
products.description: Design, engineering, and manufacturing of specialized power electronics including inverters, charge controllers, power supplies, and LED lighting for telecommunications and energy infrastructure. These are sold to external customers and integrated into Beam’s own products.

products.name: Outdoor Media Advertising on Infrastructure Products
products.description: Sale of advertising space on Beam’s infrastructure products, particularly EV ARC™ systems, generating recurring revenue through sponsorship and branding agreements. Beam retains ownership of the deployed units and monetizes through long-term sponsorships.

products.name: Aerial Drone Charging Infrastructure (BeamFlight™)
products.description: Off-grid, renewably energized, rapidly deployed charging stations and networks for aerial drone (UAV) fleets, currently under development. Intended for deployment in locations requiring autonomous drone operations.

products.name: Paper Machine Clothing (PMC)
products.description: Custom-designed, technologically sophisticated fabrics and process belts used in the manufacture of all grades of paper, paperboard, tissue, towel, and pulp. These are consumable products manufactured using polymeric materials and complex structures, delivered directly to paper manufacturers worldwide.

products.name: Engineered Fabrics (EF) for Industrial Applications
products.description: Custom-designed fabrics and belts for process industries outside of papermaking, such as nonwovens, fiber cement, corrugators, building products, tannery, and textile industries. These products are manufactured using advanced textile processes and are designed to improve production rates and lower operational costs for industrial customers.

products.name: Advanced Composite Engineered Components for Aerospace and Defense
products.description: Highly engineered, advanced composite parts and assemblies for commercial and defense aerospace applications, including fan blades, fan cases, and structural components. Manufactured using proprietary 3D-woven reinforced composites, 2D laminated composites, and automated fiber placement, these products are supplied to OEMs and government programs for use in aircraft, helicopters, missiles, and space vehicles.

products.name: Vacuum Waste Tanks for Commercial Aircraft
products.description: Manufacture and supply of vacuum waste tanks for most Boeing commercial aircraft, produced using advanced composite materials and delivered as finished assemblies to aerospace OEMs.

products.name: Observability Platform
products.description: A unified SaaS platform integrating infrastructure monitoring, application performance monitoring, log management, user experience monitoring, and analytics, delivered digitally and deployed across cloud, on-premise, and hybrid environments.

products.name: Cloud Security Platform
products.description: A suite of cloud-native security products including cloud security posture management, workload security, application security, code security, SIEM, threat management, and sensitive data scanning, delivered as SaaS and integrated with observability data.

products.name: Network Monitoring
products.description: Digital monitoring and visualization of network traffic and devices across cloud, on-premise, and hybrid environments, including flow analysis and device monitoring, delivered via SaaS platform.

products.name: Incident and Event Management
products.description: AI-powered incident response, event management, and on-call scheduling tools that unify monitoring, alerting, and incident workflows for IT and operations teams, delivered digitally via the platform.

products.name: Workflow Automation and App Builder
products.description: Low-code and no-code tools for automating and orchestrating IT and business processes, and building custom applications on top of the Datadog platform, delivered as SaaS.

products.name: Product Analytics
products.description: Analytics tools providing quantitative insights into user experiences, product usage, and business outcomes, enabling data-driven product development and optimization, delivered digitally.

products.name: Data Observability
products.description: Monitoring and analytics for data pipelines and jobs, including event-driven applications and data engineering workflows, delivered as part of the SaaS platform.

products.name: Cloud Cost Management
products.description: Tools for monitoring, visualizing, and optimizing cloud infrastructure costs, integrated with observability data and delivered via SaaS.

products.name: Marketplace for Partner Applications
products.description: A digital marketplace where customers can access and purchase third-party applications built on the Datadog platform, extending its functionality.

products.name: Hapi Marketplace
products.description: A business-to-consumer digital marketplace offering over forty-seven product categories, including wellness, elderly care, auto accessories, and more. The platform is digital-only and requires logistical infrastructure for payment, licensing, and distribution.

products.name: Hapi Cafés
products.description: In-person, location-based cafés providing social experiences and community engagement, designed to operate as standalone food and beverage businesses while promoting company and affiliate products. Requires physical locations, in-person staff, and F&B operations.

products.name: Hapi Wealth Builder
products.description: A program offering in-person and digital courses, workshops, and coaching sessions focused on equity investment and wealth-building strategies. Delivered through both physical hubs and digital content, leveraging expert-led instruction.

products.name: Robotics Products (Planned)
products.description: Planned expansion into consumer and commercial robotics products, to be offered through the Hapi Marketplace. Not yet launched as of December 31, 2025. Would require physical manufacturing or sourcing and distribution.

products.name: Branded Bottled Water
products.description: Manufactured and packaged spring and purified water sold under various national, premium, and regional brands, distributed through retail, direct delivery, and exchange/refill channels across North America. Production involves sourcing water from company-owned and contracted springs, bottling at over 50 facilities, and distribution via a large logistics network.

products.name: Flavored and Enhanced Beverages
products.description: Manufactured and packaged flavored and enhanced water-based beverages, including products like Splash Refresher™ and AC+ION®, distributed through retail and direct-to-consumer channels. Production is similar to bottled water but includes additional flavoring and enhancement processes.

products.name: Water Dispensers
products.description: Physical water dispensers designed for home and business use, sold to consumers to facilitate recurring water purchases. These are manufactured and distributed through retail and direct channels.

products.name: Direct Delivery Hydration Solutions
products.description: Recurring delivery service of bottled water and hydration products directly to homes and businesses, utilizing a dedicated delivery fleet and logistics infrastructure. Involves physical distribution and customer service operations.

products.name: Exchange and Refill Water Services
products.description: Retail-based services allowing consumers to purchase, exchange, or refill multi-use water bottles at thousands of locations and self-service stations, supporting circular packaging and sustainability. Involves logistics, retail partnerships, and maintenance of refill stations.

products.name: Water Filtration Units and Services
products.description: Sales and installation of water filtration equipment for home and business customers, providing ongoing filtration services across North America. Involves physical equipment and service support.

products.name: Third-Party Beverage Distribution
products.description: Distribution of select third-party beverage brands through Primo Brands’ logistics and retail network, leveraging existing infrastructure to expand product offerings beyond proprietary brands.

products.name: Protein Bars
products.description: Convenient, protein-rich snack bars produced via contract manufacturing, marketed under Quest and Atkins brands, and distributed through retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Ready-to-Drink (RTD) Protein Shakes and Beverages
products.description: Shelf-stable, protein-rich beverages, including milk-based and plant-based shakes, produced by contract manufacturers and sold under Quest, Atkins, and OWYN brands through retail and online channels.

products.name: Protein Salty Snacks (Chips, Crackers, etc.)
products.description: High-protein, low-carb salty snacks such as chips and crackers, manufactured externally and sold primarily under the Quest brand in various retail and e-commerce outlets.

products.name: Protein Cookies, Muffins, and Brownies
products.description: High-protein, low-carb baked snacks including cookies, muffins, and brownies, produced via contract manufacturing and sold under the Quest brand as convenient, nutritious snacks.

products.name: Confectionery Products
products.description: Protein-rich, low-sugar confections such as peanut butter cups, caramel candy bites, and chocolate-coated candies, manufactured externally and sold under Quest and Atkins brands.

products.name: Protein Powders
products.description: Plant-based and dairy-based protein powders, including allergen-sensitive formulations, produced by contract manufacturers and sold under the OWYN brand for convenient protein supplementation.

products.name: Life Insurance
products.description: The company sells and services various life insurance products, including funeral plans, interest-sensitive life insurance, and traditional life insurance, primarily through a commissioned sales force and independent agents across 42 states. These products are underwritten and administered by the company's insurance subsidiaries.

products.name: Annuity Products
products.description: The company offers single premium deferred annuities, flexible premium deferred annuities, and immediate annuities, which are sold primarily to middle to older age individuals through direct agents and in conjunction with other insurance sales.

products.name: Accident and Health Insurance
products.description: The company services small blocks of accident and health insurance policies acquired through acquisitions, including a discontinued diver’s accident insurance product, marketed primarily through the internet.

products.name: Cemetery and Mortuary Services and Products
products.description: The company provides cemetery and mortuary services, including funeral services, cremation, and the sale of related products such as plots, vaults, crypts, markers, caskets, and urns, both on a pre-need and at-need basis, through its network of cemeteries and mortuaries in Utah, California, and New Mexico.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: The company originates, underwrites, and sells residential mortgage loans for new construction, existing homes, and other real estate projects through 85 retail offices in 25 states, operating as an approved mortgage lender for HUD, Fannie Mae, and other investors.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Development and Leasing
products.description: The company develops and leases commercial real estate, including large-scale office developments such as the Center53 Development, which involves multi-phase construction and leasing of office space and parking structures on company-owned land.

products.name: Oil and Natural Gas Production
products.description: The company acquires, develops, and produces oil and natural gas by investing in non-operated working and mineral interests in oil and natural gas properties, primarily in major U.S. basins. Production is achieved by participating alongside third-party operators in drilling and completion of wells, with the company receiving a proportionate share of production and revenue. Delivery is physical, requiring capital investment and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Finance and Accounting Automation Solutions
products.description: A suite of AI-enabled platforms and services for automating finance and accounting workflows, including bill presentment, payment processing, accounts receivable, accounts payable, procure-to-pay, and order-to-cash cycles. Delivered via proprietary cloud-based and on-premise platforms, integrating with client systems and leveraging robotic process automation and human-in-the-loop exception handling.

products.name: Request to Pay (RTP) Solutions
products.description: Open banking-enabled solutions for secure, real-time payment requests and account-to-account transfers, supporting billers and payers with unified messaging, audit trails, and multi-channel payment options. Delivered as cloud-based or integrated modules, compliant with UK and EU regulatory standards.

products.name: Enterprise Information Management (EIM) and Digital Archiving
products.description: Cloud-based and on-premise platforms for secure electronic document management, digital archiving, and information hosting, including certified solutions for regulated industries. Services include ingestion, structuring, storage, and controlled access to enterprise data and documents.

products.name: Agentic AI-Enabled Robotic Process Automation (RPA)
products.description: Automation services using proprietary agentic AI and RPA tools to simulate human activities and automate business processes, especially for legacy systems lacking APIs. Delivered as embedded modules within broader workflow solutions or as standalone automation projects.

products.name: Digital Mailroom (DMR) Solutions
products.description: End-to-end mailroom outsourcing and automation services, digitizing physical mail and routing documents using AI-enabled classification and intelligent document processing. Delivered via processing centers or on client premises, integrating with workflow and document management platforms.

products.name: Workflow Automation Platforms
products.description: Proprietary platforms for automating and orchestrating business workflows, including enterprise, interdepartmental, and case management solutions. Offered as on-premise, SaaS, or shrink-wrapped software, with configurable interfaces and integration with client systems.

products.name: Legal Administration Services
products.description: Comprehensive administration services for legal and regulatory matters, including class action settlements, mass torts, product recalls, and data breach responses. Services include notification campaigns, claims processing, fund distribution, and contact center operations, leveraging automation and compliance infrastructure.

products.name: Integrated Marketing Communications
products.description: Technology-enabled services for designing, producing, and delivering high-volume client communications (statements, invoices, checks, marketing materials) across digital and physical channels. Includes document composition, workflow automation, print/mail production, and cloud-based asset management platforms.

products.name: Smart Office Solutions
products.description: Enterprise IoT solutions for facility management and workplace optimization, integrating mobile applications, occupancy sensors, digital lockers, and analytics to manage space utilization and automate physical workflows. Delivered as a unified platform connecting physical and digital office infrastructure.

products.name: Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and Payer/Provider Solutions
products.description: End-to-end revenue cycle management and operational services for healthcare payers and providers, including claims processing, medical coding, payment integrity, enrollment, and compliance. Delivered via cloud-based platforms and automation, with human expertise for complex exceptions.

products.name: Banking and Financial Industry Solutions
products.description: Payment processing, payment enablement, mortgage and loan management, compliance, and information management solutions for financial institutions. Includes support for multiple payment channels, regulatory compliance, and outsourcing of payment infrastructure and operations.

products.name: Liquidity and Disbursement Solutions
products.description: AI-enabled platforms for facilitating capital flow, including expedited government disbursements and payment routing for SMBs and lending institutions. Delivered as proprietary automation services connecting clients to financial networks.

products.name: Cross Border Payment Services
products.description: Foreign currency payment processing and compliance services for banks, including adherence to international sanctions and regulatory regimes. Delivered as managed services for complex international payment workflows.

products.name: Check Digitization Solutions
products.description: Mobile and remote deposit technologies and digital check processing infrastructure for banks, supporting image clearing systems and compliance with national standards. Delivered as technology platforms and integration services.

products.name: Public Sector Workflow and Payment Solutions
products.description: Technology and services for government agencies, including pension administration, tax processing, payment operations, citizen communications, and compliance. Delivered via secure, compliant infrastructure and AI-enabled platforms tailored to public sector requirements.

products.name: Insurance Industry Automation Solutions
products.description: Digital transformation and automation services for insurance companies, covering underwriting, enrollments, premium payments, claims, fraud detection, and integrated communications. Delivered via web portals and workflow platforms for improved client experience and risk management.

products.name: Radar Systems
products.description: High-performing, lightweight, and cost-effective multi-mode surveillance and weather avoidance radar systems for aircraft, UAVs, and shipboard platforms, manufactured using advanced electronic subassemblies and integrated systems for aerospace and defense applications.

products.name: Surveillance and Air Traffic Control Systems
products.description: Integrated IFF, Monopulse Secondary Surveillance Radars, and Air Traffic Control systems enabling identification and tracking of aircraft and vehicles, produced for military and civilian customers using advanced electronic and RF technologies.

products.name: Communications Systems
products.description: Advanced wired and wireless communication systems, including vehicle-based intercommunications, designed and manufactured for defense and civil platforms, leveraging RF and digital technologies for robust connectivity.

products.name: RF and Microwave Assemblies
products.description: Specialized multi-chip RF modules and components for radar, antennas, and wireless applications, designed, produced, and tested for defense, avionics, satellite, telecommunications, networking, and automotive markets, using advanced assembly and testing processes.

products.name: Passive RF Components
products.description: Off-the-shelf surface mount microwave components providing passive microwave signal distribution, manufactured for use in cellular base stations, WLAN, Bluetooth, satellite TV, and 5G applications, using automated production equipment.

products.name: Advanced Ceramic RF Components and Modules
products.description: Standard and etched thick-film ceramic substrates and modules, custom-designed for high-performance RF applications in medical, industrial, and defense markets, produced using proprietary ceramic and thick-film processes.

products.name: Hi-Reliability Multi-Chip Modules
products.description: Custom hybrid and multi-chip modules, including radiation-hardened and space-qualified microelectronics and power management/control electronics, manufactured using advanced chip and wire and 2.5DHI packaging assembly for high-reliability applications.

products.name: Beamforming and Switching Networks
products.description: Passive and active beamforming technologies and high-performance RF assemblies for military and space applications, including radar AESA RF networks and Butler matrices, produced using advanced RF design and assembly processes.

products.name: Custom Designed ASICs
products.description: Mixed-signal custom ASICs for automotive, industrial, defense/avionics, and smart energy markets, designed and developed from specification through qualification and volume production, leveraging in-house engineering and manufacturing capabilities.

products.name: Printed Circuit Boards (PCBs)
products.description: A broad range of advanced technology PCBs, including conventional multilayer, high-density interconnect (HDI), substrate-like (SLP), flexible, and rigid-flex PCBs, manufactured using sophisticated processes such as fine line circuitry, microvias, and advanced materials for diverse electronic applications.

products.name: Custom Electronic Assemblies
products.description: Custom electronic assemblies including backplane, mid-plane, flexible, rigid-flex, RF assemblies, and chassis integration, involving mounting components to PCBs and testing for electrical continuity, produced in specialized assembly facilities.

products.name: IC Substrates
products.description: Highly miniaturized circuits providing mechanical support and electrical interconnect for packaging ICs in single or multi-chip modules, manufactured in clean room environments using advanced HDI and SLP processes.

products.name: Quick Turnaround and Prototype PCB Services
products.description: Custom-fabricated PCBs and prototypes delivered within 24 hours to 15 days, including ramp-to-volume services, leveraging rapid manufacturing and engineering capabilities for time-critical customer requirements.

products.name: Thermal Management PCBs
products.description: PCBs with integrated thermal management features such as heavy copper cores, embedded/passive heat sinks, and thermal cores, manufactured to improve heat dissipation in high-density electronic assemblies.

products.name: Value-Added Engineering and Design Services
products.description: Design-for-manufacturability (DFM), PCB layout design, simulation, testing, and specialized RF assembly/testing services, provided as complementary offerings to support customer product development and manufacturing.

products.name: Ozekibart (INBRX-109)
products.description: A tetravalent agonistic antibody targeting DR5, developed using proprietary single domain antibody technology, designed to induce cancer-selective programmed cell death. Delivered as a biologic therapeutic via infusion, manufactured through recombinant protein engineering and subject to regulatory approval for oncology indications.

products.name: INBRX-106
products.description: A hexavalent OX40 agonist biologic therapeutic, engineered to provide immune co-stimulation for enhanced anti-tumor immunity. Delivered as an infused biologic, produced via recombinant protein engineering, and evaluated as both a single agent and in combination with checkpoint inhibitors for solid tumor oncology indications.

products.name: Online Talent Marketplace
products.description: A digital platform (Upwork Marketplace) that connects businesses with independent professionals and agencies for a wide range of freelance and project-based work, leveraging AI-powered matching, collaboration, and payment tools. Delivered entirely online, it enables remote work engagements globally.

products.name: Enterprise Workforce Solutions
products.description: A suite of scalable, flexible solutions (delivered through Lifted) for enterprise clients to source, contract, manage, and pay contingent talent, including independent contractors, staff augmentation, AOR, EOR, and outsourcing, with compliance, reporting, and payment features. Delivered via a dedicated platform and service model for large organizations.

products.name: Managed Services
products.description: End-to-end project delivery and program management services for enterprise clients, where Upwork (via Lifted) assumes responsibility for delivering defined work outcomes by engaging and managing talent directly or through third-party staffing providers. Delivered as a service-led solution with direct client invoicing.

products.name: Payroll Services
products.description: Payroll and employment services (Upwork Payroll) for clients who wish to engage talent found on Upwork as employees, utilizing third-party staffing providers to handle employment, payroll, and compliance. Delivered through partnerships with staffing firms integrated into the Upwork platform.

products.name: Value-Added Platform Services (Ads, Memberships, Currency, Payment Processing)
products.description: A set of ancillary digital services offered through the Upwork platform, including advertising and monetization products, talent memberships, virtual tokens (Connects), payment processing, and foreign currency exchange. Delivered digitally to enhance marketplace efficiency and user experience.

products.name: Work Management Platform
products.description: A cloud-based, SaaS platform that enables organizations to plan, execute, and track projects, processes, and workflows across teams, integrating both human and AI agents. Delivered digitally, it includes features for project management, resource allocation, reporting, and strategic planning, and is available in tiered subscription models.

products.name: AI Teammates
products.description: Collaborative AI agents integrated into the platform that automate and execute ambiguous, evolving work, acting as virtual team members to accelerate outcomes. Delivered as a digital feature within the platform, requiring no additional headcount.

products.name: AI Studio
products.description: A digital tool within the platform for designing and automating routine, structured, and repeatable workflows using AI, allowing teams to build custom AI-driven processes for tasks such as intake and triage.

products.name: Asana Gov
products.description: A secure, FedRAMP-compliant version of the Asana platform tailored for government agencies and regulated industries, providing enhanced security and compliance features while delivering the core work management capabilities.

products.name: Platform Integrations and API
products.description: APIs and integration capabilities that allow customers and developers to connect Asana with over 300 third-party applications, enabling extensibility and workflow automation across digital tools. Delivered digitally as part of the platform.

products.name: Professional Services and Customer Support
products.description: Consulting, onboarding, training, and managed services offered to help customers implement, customize, and maximize value from the Asana platform. Delivered through human expertise, both remotely and onsite, and supported by a global partner network.

products.name: Secured Debt Investments to Middle Market Companies
products.description: Origination and management of secured debt instruments, primarily first lien and second lien senior secured loans, to U.S. middle market companies. These loans are directly originated and require significant financial capital, underwriting, and ongoing portfolio management.

products.name: Subordinated Debt and Unsecured Debt Investments
products.description: Provision of higher-yielding debt investments, including unsecured and subordinated debt, to middle market companies. These are typically minority allocations and involve higher risk and yield, requiring financial structuring and credit analysis.

products.name: Equity and Preferred Equity Co-Investments
products.description: Equity and preferred equity investments, often as co-investments alongside debt financings, in portfolio companies. These are typically structured as minority stakes and require financial analysis and ongoing monitoring.

products.name: Structured Credit and Investment Fund Interests
products.description: Investments in structured credit products and interests in investment funds, including joint ventures and collateralized loan obligations, which provide exposure to diversified pools of loans and credit assets. These are managed through financial structuring and partnership arrangements.

products.name: Lorundrostat
products.description: A proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor (ASI) developed for the treatment of cardiorenal conditions affected by dysregulated aldosterone, including hypertension and related comorbidities such as chronic kidney disease (CKD) and obstructive sleep apnea (OSA). Lorundrostat is produced via pharmaceutical manufacturing and delivered as an oral medication, pending regulatory approval.

products.name: Electric Transmission and Distribution Services (California)
products.description: Provision of regulated electric transmission and distribution services to residential, commercial, industrial, and municipal customers in Southern California, primarily through SDG&E. Services are delivered via extensive overhead and underground lines and substations, supported by regulated infrastructure and in-person labor.

products.name: Natural Gas Distribution, Transmission, and Storage Services (California)
products.description: Provision of regulated natural gas distribution, transmission, and storage services to residential, commercial, industrial, and electric generation customers in Southern and Central California, primarily through SoCalGas and SDG&E. Services are delivered via extensive pipeline networks and storage facilities, requiring regulated infrastructure and in-person operations.

products.name: Electric Transmission and Distribution Services (Texas)
products.description: Provision of regulated electricity transmission and distribution services to end-use consumers, retail electric providers, and wholesale customers in Texas, primarily through Oncor and Sharyland Utilities. Services are delivered via extensive transmission and distribution lines and substations, supported by regulated infrastructure and in-person labor.

products.name: LNG Liquefaction, Export, and Regasification Services
products.description: Development, construction, ownership, and operation of natural gas liquefaction, export, and regasification facilities in the U.S. and Mexico, providing LNG processing and terminal services to global energy companies under long-term contracts. Requires large-scale physical infrastructure, regulatory approvals, and capital-intensive operations.

products.name: Natural Gas Pipeline Transportation Services (U.S. and Mexico)
products.description: Development, construction, ownership, and operation of natural gas and ethane pipeline systems for the receipt, transportation, compression, and delivery of natural gas and ethane in the U.S. and Mexico. Services are provided under long-term contracts to utilities and industrial customers, requiring regulated, capital-intensive infrastructure.

products.name: Natural Gas Distribution Services (Mexico)
products.description: Provision of regulated natural gas distribution services to residential, commercial, and industrial customers in Mexico through Ecogas, using pipeline networks and metering infrastructure. Services are regulated and require physical infrastructure and in-person operations.

products.name: LPG Storage and Transportation Services (Mexico)
products.description: Ownership and operation of LPG pipeline systems and storage terminals in Mexico, providing storage and transportation services to energy companies under long-term contracts. Requires physical infrastructure and regulated operations.

products.name: Refined Products Storage Services (Mexico)
products.description: Development, construction, ownership, and operation of refined products storage terminals for gasoline, diesel, and jet fuel in Mexico, providing storage services to private companies under long-term contracts. Requires large-scale physical infrastructure and regulated operations.

products.name: Renewable Power Generation (Mexico and Cross-Border)
products.description: Development, construction, ownership, and operation of wind and solar power generation facilities in Mexico, selling electricity under long-term PPAs to load-serving entities and industrial customers, including exports to the U.S. Requires physical generation assets and is subject to regulatory and market conditions.

products.name: Natural Gas-Fired Power Generation (Mexico)
products.description: Ownership and operation of natural gas-fired, combined-cycle power plants in Mexico, selling electricity and resource adequacy to utilities and wholesale power marketers, including cross-border sales to the U.S. Delivered via physical generation assets and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Low Carbon Solutions and Carbon Capture Projects
products.description: Development, construction, and operation of infrastructure for carbon capture and storage, and generation and storage of low carbon energy, including new wind projects and carbon sequestration facilities. Delivered via physical assets and advanced technology, often in partnership with other energy companies.

products.name: Precision Oncology Therapeutics
products.description: Novel small molecule and biologic drugs designed to target specific cancer driver mechanisms, including kinase inhibitors, targeted protein degraders, and antibody-drug conjugates. These therapeutics are discovered and developed using proprietary drug discovery platforms and are advanced through preclinical and clinical development for solid tumors and hematological malignancies.

products.name: JAK2V617F Inhibitor Program
products.description: A program focused on developing mutant-selective allosteric inhibitors targeting the JAK2V617F mutation, primarily for myeloproliferative neoplasms. These are small molecule drugs designed and developed internally, currently in preclinical and early clinical stages.

products.name: KAT6A Selective Degrader Program
products.description: Development of highly potent, selective small molecule degraders targeting KAT6A for the treatment of advanced breast cancer and other solid tumors. These are orally administered drugs with preclinical efficacy and are advancing toward clinical trials.

products.name: Precision Antibody Drug Conjugates (ADCs) and Degrader Antibody Conjugates (DACs)
products.description: Jointly developed with partners, these are antibody-based therapeutics conjugated with proprietary degrader payloads, designed to target tumor-specific antigens and deliver highly potent, selective anti-cancer agents. Includes both internal and partnered programs, with manufacturing and commercialization responsibilities shared or licensed.

products.name: SMARCA2 Selective Degrader Program
products.description: Development of small molecule degraders selectively targeting SMARCA2 for cancers deficient in SMARCA4, aiming to induce synthetic lethality in tumor cells. The program includes highly selective compounds with demonstrated preclinical activity, though clinical development is currently paused.

products.name: Degrader Payload Platform for ADCs/DACs
products.description: A proprietary platform for designing and engineering targeted protein degrader payloads for use in antibody-drug conjugates, aiming to improve efficacy and tolerability compared to traditional cytotoxic payloads. These payloads are licensed to partners and used in both internal and external ADC/DAC programs.

products.name: Recruitment Packages
products.description: Subscription-based software services that provide employers with access to candidate profiles, resume databases, and the ability to post jobs on specialized online platforms. Delivered digitally via web and mobile applications, these packages are the primary revenue driver and are tailored for technology and security-cleared professionals.

products.name: Job Postings
products.description: Online job advertising services focused on technology and security-cleared roles, allowing employers to promote open positions to targeted professional communities. Delivered through web and mobile platforms, these postings are available individually or as part of bundled packages.

products.name: Talent Sourcing Services
products.description: Premium staffing services that deliver sourced and screened contract or full-time candidates to recruiters and employers. This service involves in-person human labor and digital tools to identify, vet, and present qualified candidates.

products.name: Applicant Tracking System (AgileATS)
products.description: A premium add-on software solution that automates job postings, streamlines recruiting workflows, and enhances sourcing capabilities for employers, particularly in the government technology sector. Delivered as a digital SaaS product integrated with the ClearanceJobs platform.

products.name: Employer Branding and Advertising Solutions
products.description: A suite of digital marketing services including display advertising, email campaigns, enhanced job postings, and company profiles to help employers amplify their brand and reach targeted professional audiences. Delivered through the company's online platforms.

products.name: Career Development Content and Data Services
products.description: Digital content and analytics services providing professionals with career management tools, market and salary information, and employers with workforce intelligence and recruiting insights. Delivered via web platforms and tailored reports.

products.name: Virtual and Live Career Events
products.description: Online and in-person career events connecting employers with candidates, including job fairs and networking sessions. These events facilitate direct engagement and are offered as part of the company's service portfolio.

products.name: Premium Candidate Experience Subscription
products.description: A paid subscription service for security-cleared professionals that enhances their visibility to recruiters on the ClearanceJobs platform, providing additional features to improve job search outcomes. Delivered digitally through the platform.

products.name: Structured Real Estate Financing
products.description: Provision of customized structured finance products including bridge loans, mezzanine loans, preferred equity, and construction loans for multifamily, single-family rental, and other commercial real estate assets. These are originated, underwritten, and serviced directly by the company and require significant financial capital, underwriting expertise, and risk management.

products.name: Agency Loan Origination and Servicing
products.description: Origination, sale, and servicing of multifamily and related mortgage loans through government-sponsored enterprise (GSE) programs (Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, Ginnie Mae, FHA, HUD) and private label/conduit programs. Involves in-house underwriting, loan sales, and retention of servicing rights, leveraging regulated infrastructure and compliance with agency guidelines.

products.name: Single-Family Rental (SFR) Financing
products.description: Provision of financing solutions for single-family rental properties, including bridge, build-to-rent, line of credit, and long-term fixed rate loans. These products are originated, underwritten, and serviced by the company and may be sold to third-party investors or securitized.

products.name: Mortgage Servicing
products.description: Servicing of mortgage loans originated by the company, including collection of payments, management of escrow accounts, and asset management responsibilities. This is performed internally and generates recurring fee income from both structured and agency-originated loans.

products.name: Real Estate Investment and Asset Management
products.description: Direct investment in real estate properties (typically through foreclosure or settlement of mortgage debt) and management of these assets to maximize value, including renovation, leasing, and disposition. Requires capital investment and active asset management.

products.name: Investment in Mortgage-Related Securities
products.description: Investment in mortgage-backed securities and related debt instruments, including those issued by Freddie Mac SBL securitizations and APL certificates. These are typically purchased at a discount and held for yield.

products.name: Multifamily Apartment Rental Services
products.description: Ownership, operation, leasing, and management of apartment communities, including garden style, mid-rise, and high-rise properties, primarily in the Southeast, Southwest, and Mid-Atlantic regions. Delivered through physical real estate assets and in-person property management, supported by digital leasing and resident services.

products.name: Apartment Community Development Services
products.description: Development of new apartment communities, including ground-up construction and expansion of existing properties, conducted through wholly-owned entities or joint ventures. Involves physical construction, project management, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Apartment Community Redevelopment and Renovation Services
products.description: Renovation and repositioning of existing apartment communities, including interior unit upgrades, amenity enhancements, and common area improvements, to support rent growth and maintain competitive positioning. Delivered through capital investment and construction services.

products.name: Smart Home Technology and WiFi Services for Residents
products.description: Installation and provision of smart home technology (e.g., entry locks, mobile control of lights and thermostat, leak monitoring) and WiFi retrofits in apartment units, enhancing resident experience and supporting rent growth. Delivered through technology integration and infrastructure upgrades.

products.name: Retail Space Leasing within Apartment Communities
products.description: Leasing of retail components integrated within certain apartment communities, providing commercial space to external retail tenants. Delivered through physical real estate assets as part of mixed-use developments.

products.name: Fast-Casual Restaurant Dining
products.description: Operation of fast-casual restaurants offering cooked-to-order, globally-inspired noodle and pasta dishes, salads, soups, and appetizers, served in-restaurant, for takeout, or delivery. Food is prepared in full kitchens with fresh ingredients and a high degree of customization.

products.name: Franchise Restaurant Operations
products.description: Franchising of the Noodles & Company restaurant concept, providing franchisees with rights to operate branded restaurants and access to menu, systems, and support. Franchisees operate under development agreements and utilize company technology and marketing platforms.

products.name: Nurse Staffing Services
products.description: Provision of temporary and permanent nurse staffing solutions, including travel, international, crisis, labor disruption, and local assignments, delivered through rigorous recruitment, credentialing, and placement processes for healthcare facilities nationwide.

products.name: Allied Health Staffing Services
products.description: Provision of allied health professionals, such as therapists, technologists, and pharmacists, to healthcare facilities and schools, including teletherapy services, through recruitment, credentialing, and placement processes.

products.name: Physician and Advanced Practice Staffing Services
products.description: Provision of locum tenens and permanent placement services for physicians and advanced practice clinicians across all specialties, delivered through recruitment and placement for temporary and full-time roles at healthcare organizations.

products.name: Interim Leadership Staffing Services
products.description: Provision of interim executive and clinical leadership staffing, including senior healthcare executives and operational leaders, to healthcare organizations for temporary strategic guidance and operational support.

products.name: Executive and Academic Leadership Search Services
products.description: Provision of executive search services for permanent placement of healthcare leaders, with a focus on academic medical centers and children’s hospitals, utilizing specialized recruitment processes.

products.name: Managed Services Programs (MSP)
products.description: Comprehensive management of clients’ contingent healthcare staffing needs, including placement of AMN and third-party professionals, using proprietary technology to optimize efficiency and cost savings.

products.name: Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO) and Recruitment Solutions
products.description: Outsourced recruitment and onboarding of permanent clinical and nonclinical staff for healthcare organizations, using technology and data intelligence to deliver customized, scalable hiring solutions.

products.name: Workforce Consulting and Staff Planning Services
products.description: Consulting services to evaluate and optimize healthcare organizations’ staffing spend, workforce, and scheduling capabilities, delivered by expert consultants using data-driven analysis.

products.name: Revenue Cycle Solutions
products.description: Provision of skilled labor for remote medical coding, clinical documentation improvement, case management, clinical data registry, and related auditing and advisory services, delivered through specialized professionals and technology.

products.name: Healthcare Language Interpretation Services
products.description: Provision of medical language interpretation services via proprietary technology platforms, including video remote, phone, onsite, and telehealth-integrated solutions, supporting real-time communication for healthcare providers.

products.name: Vendor Management Systems (VMS)
products.description: Provision of SaaS-based vendor management systems for healthcare organizations to self-manage procurement of contingent clinical labor and internal float pools, offering consolidated reporting and workflow automation.
